_comment: TEMPLATE for evaluation contract v3. Copy into specs/<NNN>-<feature>/gate-config.json, fill the window and margins, then FREEZE (record the hash) BEFORE looking at any OOS number. Keys starting with '_' are excluded from the canonical hash, so anything that must be frozen has to be a REAL key. A v2 config fails closed under --confirmatory on purpose: its verdict was judged under different rules.
_min_effect_delta: Applies to the POINT ESTIMATE (diff < -delta), separately from ci_high < 0. 0.0 reproduces pre-091 behaviour. Set it above 0 when a hair's-width win would not be worth adopting; note the recorded instrument needs ~0.006 for 80% power, so a delta near 0.002 is already at the edge of what can be measured.

recent_guard._comment: EVIDENCE-OF-HARM veto (ci_low > margin), NOT a non-inferiority test. Passing means 'no degradation beyond the margin was detected in the recent window'. v2's zero-tolerance point-estimate sign test is still reachable via mode='legacy_point_estimate', for reproducing a v1/v2 verdict only.

subgroup_guard._comment: Only FAIL (confidently worse than the margin) or MISSING (never computed) blocks adoption. PASS in every critical subgroup yields subgroup_assurance='full'; anything else yields 'partial' plus a per-subgroup residual_risk. Declare ONLY subgroups this feature could plausibly move — 088/090 both carried critical subgroups unrelated to what they changed.
subgroup_guard._naming: Prefer the stable names (recent_year_only / recent_year_nk); the year-stamped aliases (2026_only) resolve to the same subgroup while target_year matches.
subgroup_guard._target_year: Omit to follow the eval window's latest year; pin an integer only when the pre-registration deliberately freezes it.

eval_window._comment: 'to' is fixed at freeze time to the latest settled race date then; --from and --to must BOTH be passed and must match, or assert_confirmatory fails closed.

bootstrap._comment: Shared by the primary CI, the recent-window guard and every subgroup CI, so they cannot drift apart.

_power: REQUIRED before freezing: state the effect size this window can actually detect. Compute SE from a prior run of comparable size, then record MDE(80%) here. The 088 record gives SE=0.000863 over 821 race-days -> MDE 0.0024 for the primary alone, ~0.006 once every guard is ANDed. Freezing a gate that cannot see the effect you are hoping for produces a REJECT that means nothing.

verdict._comment: Single source of truth. Individual numbers must not be re-read post hoc to argue a different outcome.
verdict.formula: gate.adopted AND subgroup_guard_status NOT IN {FAIL, MISSING}
verdict.no_decision: when the evaluation cannot be run, when the window is too short, or when the point estimate favours the candidate but the CI straddles zero; never because a number is borderline
